name: Norway
summary: Scandinavian coastal nation with deep fjord topography. World leader in electric passenger vehicle adoption and virtually 100% renewable domestic power generation powered by high-head mountain reservoirs.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.22x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); pristine coastal air with localized winter residential wood smoke monitoring.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; warming accelerates retreat of mainland and Svalbard glaciers.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming trend across Norwegian meteorological stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.1% share of global emissions; offshore North Sea petroleum extraction drives remaining emissions.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Offshore drilling platforms and offshore supply vessels sustain per capita fossil totals.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Extensive boreal conifer forests and coastal birch woodlands covering ~122,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Almost entirely zero-carbon grid: high-head hydropower reservoirs provided 88.6% and wind 9.8%.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Sparse population density of 15 people/km²; urban population fraction is 83.5%.
